entries: There are 50 Spaceship Parts scattered around San Andreas. They can be collected by any protagonist, but Franklin begins and finishes Omega's related mission chain. Collecting all 50 is required for 100% completion.

There are 50 Letter Scraps across San Andreas. Completing the set reveals the Leonora Johnson letter and unlocks Franklin's confrontation connected to Peter Dreyfuss. The set is required for 100% completion.

Michael can collect 30 Submarine Pieces for Abigail Mathers' optional storyline after the Sonar Collections Dock content becomes available. This collectible set is not required for the main 100% checklist.
After purchasing the Sonar Collections Dock, the player can use the submersible to collect 30 Nuclear Waste barrels. The activity pays money but is not required for the main 100% checklist.
The Epsilon storyline can lead to 10 Epsilon Tracts placed around the map. They are optional and not required for the standard 100% completion checklist.
GTA V has 50 Unique Stunt Jumps. Completing 25 contributes to 100% completion, while completing all 50 is tied to the Show Off achievement/trophy.
There are 50 Under the Bridge flight challenges. Completing 25 contributes to 100% completion; completing all 50 is part of the Close Shave achievement/trophy requirement together with Knife Flights.
There are 15 Knife Flight challenges between buildings. Completing 8 contributes to 100% completion, while all 15 are needed for the full Close Shave achievement/trophy requirement.
San Andreas Flight School contains 12 lessons in Story Mode. Earning at least bronze in all 12 contributes to 100% completion and also helps improve the protagonist's Flying stat.

Story Mode shooting ranges contain 18 required challenges across six weapon categories for the 100% checklist. They are also an efficient way to improve Shooting skill and earn weapon-store discounts.
Hao introduces Franklin to five Story Mode street races. Earning the required medal in each contributes to 100% completion.
off road races gta v story
There are six Off-Road Races that count toward 100% completion when the player earns the required placement or medal.
There are four Sea Races in Story Mode. Completing them with the required placement contributes to 100% completion.
Story Mode has three triathlons. Completing them with the required placement contributes to 100% completion and is useful for Stamina training.
Franklin can complete 13 parachute jumps, split between helicopter and base jumps. Completing the full set is required for Dom's final mission and contributes to 100% completion.
For the 100% checklist, complete a nine-hole round of golf and finish at even par or better. Golf also contributes to Strength training.
Winning a game of tennis contributes to 100% completion. Tennis is also one of the activities that can help raise Strength.
Winning a game of darts contributes to 100% completion. Darts can also be used as a friend activity with compatible protagonists.
Trevor can unlock hunting through Cletus. Hunting includes animal tracking and shooting challenges in Blaine County but is not required for the main 100% checklist.
Maude gives Trevor Bail Bond targets. Trevor earns more for returning targets alive than for killing them, and the missions can unlock the Wanted: Alive or Alive achievement/trophy.
After Trevor purchases McKenzie Field Hangar, he can run Arms Trafficking air and ground missions for recurring payments. These activities are optional for 100% completion.
Tonya's Strangers & Freaks chain introduces Franklin to towing work. After the chain, towing is also tied to the LSPD Auto Impound property if purchased.
Taxi work can be performed in Story Mode, and purchasing Downtown Cab Co. unlocks special Private Taxi Fares for Franklin in addition to normal passenger jobs.

Story Mode lets the protagonists purchase selected businesses and facilities. Properties vary by character, purchase price, weekly income, and optional management missions. Buying any five eligible properties contributes to 100% completion.
downtown cab co gta v property
Downtown Cab Co. is a Story Mode property Franklin can buy. It generates income and unlocks Private Taxi Fares, including special passenger missions.
mckenzie field hangar property gta v
McKenzie Field Hangar is a Trevor property in Grapeseed. Owning it unlocks recurring Arms Trafficking air and ground missions.
The Sonar Collections Dock is a purchasable coastal property that provides access to a submersible and the Nuclear Waste collection activity.
Several cinemas can be purchased in Story Mode by eligible protagonists. They generate income and may trigger occasional property-management tasks.
los santos golf club property gta v
most expensive property gta v story
The Los Santos Golf Club is one of the most expensive purchasable Story Mode properties. It provides recurring income but requires a very large upfront investment.
Trevor gains control of the Vanilla Unicorn through the story rather than buying it through a normal property purchase sign. It functions as one of his later bases.
how stock market works gta v story

Story Mode has two stock exchanges: LCN and BAWSAQ. LCN is driven mainly by in-game conditions, while BAWSAQ depends on Rockstar's online services. Mission events, especially Lester's assassinations, can create major investment opportunities.
when do lester assassinations gta v
best time assassination missions gta v

Only The Hotel Assassination is required during the main story. To maximize investment profit, players commonly save the other four Lester assassination missions until after The Big Score, when all three protagonists have much more capital.
The Hotel Assassination affects Betta Pharmaceuticals and Bilkinton Research. Because BAWSAQ availability can vary, make a manual save and verify the exchange before committing a large investment.

The Multi Target Assassination is associated with Debonaire before the hit and a later Redwood rebound on LCN. This is one of the most profitable Story Mode stock sequences when done with large post-story capital.
The Vice Assassination is associated with Fruit and Facade on BAWSAQ. Because BAWSAQ depends on online availability, check that the exchange is functioning before relying on the trade.
The Bus Assassination's notable stock play occurs after the mission, when Vapid can be bought after its drop and held for a rebound if BAWSAQ is functioning.
The Construction Assassination is associated with buying GoldCoast on LCN before the mission and selling after the mission-driven rise.
which big score approach pays more

If maximizing payout is the goal, the obvious Big Score approach can be more profitable with efficient crew choices because it avoids a hacker and can use lower-cut crew. Exact take depends on crew selection and survival.
how heist crew improve gta v
Heist crew members who survive successful jobs can improve their skill while keeping the same percentage cut. This makes some low-cost crew members better value if reused across multiple heists.
best driver heist gta v taliana
Taliana Martinez is widely considered one of the best-value Story Mode drivers because she has strong skill for a relatively low cut after being rescued in her random event.
packie mcreary heist crew gta v
Packie McReary is an experienced gunman who can be unlocked through a random event. He is reliable, though his cut is higher than some developing crew options.

Michael can complete a long Epsilon Program Strangers & Freaks chain involving donations, clothing, desert tasks, and a final choice. The storyline is optional for normal 100% completion but tied to the Kifflom achievement/trophy.

Trevor can deliver certain hitchhikers or random-event passengers to the Altruist Camp instead of their intended destinations. After enough deliveries, the cult encounter escalates into a shootout with loot available in the camp.
